summary: Reading the novel's tribute reaches spell.c:study_book's one-time 20 XP reward. C then calls newexplevel() with the global message facility available. JavaScript calls newexplevel(state) without forwarding study_book's existing message callback, so a level-up reaches pluslvl with no message owner and aborts the replay.

source.branch: The SPE_NOVEL branch in study_book after read_tribute succeeds and u.uevent.read_tribute is still false: record the achievement, award more_experienced(20, 0), call newexplevel(), then set the one-time flag.
callers: read.c:doread -> spell.c:study_book; js/read.js:doread calls js/spell.js:study_book with message: ttyPline, prompt: y_n, and the active state.
spell.c:study_book calls exper.c:newexplevel after awarding the novel XP; JS study_book currently calls newexplevel(state) without its existing env.message owner.
dependencies: exper.c:newexplevel and exper.c:pluslvl already have JavaScript implementations in js/exper.js. Verify their existing return/message contract; this bounded correction wires study_book's message and random owners through newexplevel and does not claim either helper or whole study_book completion.

evidence: Saved v52 evaluation hosted-38292091033-1-v52.json at fcfb7afe71226851b75665b753b0c2c73ceb7af4 records this case as 0/22 screens, 0/2698 RNG and error pluslvl needs a message owner. Canonical v52 manifest digest is 38c5e274ac970a16df08fb372269edc360f8c61f507020f29f71d9335ea9f29e; recording SHA-256 is 520f0264e06e717f356079b548f9237d2b1be33aad031f4e17a6da3947a06179.

Fresh C/JavaScript differential at this worker boundary reproduced the exact runtime error. C spell.c:study_book (around lines 510-535) calls newexplevel() after more_experienced(20, 0); JS spell.js study_book lines 961-964 calls more_experienced(20, 0, state) and then await newexplevel(state). The JS helper exper.js newexplevel forwards its env to pluslvl, which throws when env.message is absent.

The production caller js/read.js:doread already passes message: ttyPline into study_book. The scoped correction must forward that message owner (and the existing random owner) only at the novel level-up call, preserving the one-time achievement and flag order.
